query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM "order" o JOIN bake_day d ON d.id = o.bake_day_id
            WHERE o.customer_id = $1
                AND (o.status = 'pending_payment'
                    OR (o.status IN ('paid', 'confirmed') AND d.date >= date 'epoch' + $2::integer))
        ) AS "open!"
